name: ステガナリシス（隠しデータ検出）
description: 検出します hidden data embedded画像内の through steganographic techniques, を示す potential 操作.
algorithm: Rich Model Steg分析 with Spatial Domain Features
mechanism: 抽出します high-dimensional 特徴 sets from spatial residuals using multiple filter kernels. 分析します 統計的 properties disrupted when data is hidden in LSBs or transform 係数.
parameters: Feature dimension: 34671 (full SRM), Filters: 30 linear + nonlinear, Quantization: T=1,2,3, Classifier: ensemble
source: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting hidden payloads画像内の that may indicate data exfiltration or tamper concealment

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Extremely high-dimensional 特徴
• Covers wide range of embedding methods
• State-of-the-art 検出 rates
• Generalizes にわたる steganographic algorithms
limitations:
• Very high computational cost
• Requires training data per embedding rate
• Large 特徴 vectors need dimensionality reduction
• May produce 誤検出 on noisy images
